text:
```yaml
name: Meeting Minutes Update

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Runs every Monday at midnight UTC

jobs:
  update-meeting-minutes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Fetch latest meeting minutes from Discourse
        id: fetch_minutes
        run: |
          curl -s https://discuss.layer5.io/latest.json?category=community | jq '.topic_list.topics[-1].posts[-1].cooked' > meeting_minutes.html

      - name: Copy meeting minutes to archive directory
        run: |
          mkdir -p .github/meetings/archive
          cp meeting_minutes.html .github/meetings/archive/

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add .github/meetings/archive/
          git commit -m "Update weekly meeting minutes"
          git push origin main
```
